rule: Every branch receives an explicit bounded role. No cross-branch evidence transfer without bridge evidence.

branches.application: Routes heterogeneous probes; converge/split/UNRESOLVED; no truth-by-agreement.
Stable identity, integrity, exact source payload lookup; never semantic proof.
Selective retrieval, task-local active carrier, preserve cold source evidence.
Admission/provenance boundary; separate source, reconstruction, interpretation, proposal.
Selective activation; correctness != economic utility; amortization must replicate.
Navigation/recovery lineage only; no current scientific authority transferred.
Method executes inquiry; evidence decides truth; bounded tests stay bounded.
Compile repeated relations into active executable carrier while retaining slower reconstructible evidence.
Finite exhaustive semantic-equivalence and alternate-verifier pattern.
Preserve consequential meaning while reducing reconstruction burden; definitions stay task-local.
Incomplete search/timeout stays UNKNOWN; structured-control search provides failure and circuit counterexamples.
Continuous parameter adaptation not currently the bottleneck; requires matched fixed baseline before activation.
Fast candidate relation retrieval only; retrieval does not imply proof.
Rank/nullspace, observer dependence, lost-degree tests, affine-rank geometry.
Discrete identity + continuous contour / removal-before-addition proposals; no demonstrated proof advantage.
Perturbation/mutation search; benchmark any candidate against exact controls.
Constrained mutation and feature-pack cost; semantic validity alone does not earn promotion.
Frozen manifests, exact hashes, one-factor lesions, utility separate from component correctness.
Diverse hypothesis generation; generated ideas cannot self-verify.
Matched baselines, seed-wise aggregation, capacity/collision diagnostics, preserve negative results.
Factorization/observer interventions; use only where a current representation hypothesis needs causal pressure.
Diagnosis != intervention; anti-circularity and multi-seed robustness before promotion.
Price compute/lifecycle/opportunity cost and protect human obligations; not mathematical evidence.
Improve/protect/discover/live/love/remain-changeable; orientation, not proof.
Human purpose and minimal necessity constrain research activity, not complexity truth.
Research outputs must remain reconstructible and usable; no complexity-theory evidence.
Preserve provenance and missing relations; historical existence cases do not establish mathematical universality.
Terminology/interface guard; prevent vocabulary from hiding distinctions.
Reduction/claim-dependency discipline; open-problem analogy cannot transfer proof.
Use as claim-ceiling discipline only; no P-vs-NP evidence transferred.
Evidence qualification / transport integrity where applicable.
Transfer obligations and bridge evidence before cross-domain promotion.
Recursive/self-similar representation proposals; verify on exact finite models before use.
Candidate branching/search representation; must beat matched search baseline.
Tree/orbit generator identity and route representation; no direct proof authority.
Domain-specific executable mathematics currently does not change the P-vs-NP obligation.
Shor/HSP/Fourier quotient tests and identifiability boundaries; no generic SAT period assumed.
Target obligation: uniform polynomial NP-complete algorithm or rigorous superpolynomial lower bound.
Exact finite SAT comparisons, cache/decomposition behavior, and timing counterexamples.
Exact composition across discovered boundaries; useful boundary need not equal planted generator.
Basis-aligned distortion detector; negative evidence against generic search superiority.
Provenance/cultural relation recovery method; no complexity proof transfer.
Necessity-first engineering lesson only; physical design does not affect current mathematical obligation.
Application tooling; no consequential P-vs-NP distinction.
Operational application branch; no consequential P-vs-NP distinction.
API/data application branch; no consequential P-vs-NP distinction.

frontiers.name: Constructive Partial-Hard / Range Avoidance
frontiers.obligation: Construct a growing partial truth table outside all circuits up to size s without enumerating the circuit population or all labels.

frontiers.name: Aggregate Satisfying-Pairs
frontiers.obligation: Evaluate enough circuit-input interactions to choose a shrinking label without paying explicit population size.

frontiers.name: DAG sharing lower-bound survival
frontiers.obligation: Any hardness measure must remain valid when subcomputations are reused.

frontiers.name: Quantum / symmetry quotient
frontiers.obligation: Use Shor/Simon/HSP only when an efficiently discoverable coset or certified partition symmetry actually exists.

frontiers.name: Proof admission
frontiers.obligation: No bounded experiment, heuristic, or generated theory may be promoted to P vs NP resolution without a complete uniform proof and barrier collision.
